message.content:
Sailboats fall under heading 8903. Subheading 8903.92 covers motorboats, other than outboard motorboats, and 8903.91 covers sailboats with or without auxiliary motor. A 30-foot sailboat with an auxiliary diesel engine therefore belongs in 8903.91.

The statistical suffixes under 8903.91 are:
- 8903.91.0100: Sailboats, with or without auxiliary motor, "Sailboats" (tariff text: "Sailboats, other than inflatable... "), commonly 8903.91.0100 for sailboats of the type used for recreation.
- 8903.91.0105 was not a valid code, and I am not relying on it.

I recall the 8903.91 structure as 8903.91.00 with the 10-digit numbers 8903.91.0130 and 8903.91.0160 (the 10-digit forms). Since the vessel is a recreational sailboat, 8903.91.0100 is the likely choice. I am working from memory and have not checked it against the schedule.

{"hts_code": "8903.91.0100", "reason": "A fiberglass recreational sailboat of about 30 feet with an auxiliary diesel engine is classified in heading 8903 as a sailboat with or without auxiliary motor, under subheading 8903.91."}
